2023_058_ki_secondary.paragraph: Two KI furniture quotations for the Troy School District "2023 Pilot Furniture" project, both created 3/1/2023, revised 3/15/2023 and valid through 4/30/2023, presented under the March 21, 2023 board agenda. Quote 23ddw-624468-13/C covers Baker rooms 102, 111, 204 and 106/room 10 with a product total and grand total of $20,211.68; quote 23ddw-624468-12/C covers IA East rooms 8, 9, 33 and 34 with a product total and grand total of $29,927.88. Both are priced under contract line OT8142CZ1, Sourcewell #121919-KII, with delivery, freight, off-loading and installation included through dealer The Interior Group of Milford, Michigan.
2023_058_ki_secondary.page:
**Overview**
KI (1330 Bellevue Street, Green Bay, WI 54302) issued two quotations to Troy School District, 4400 Livemois Rd, Troy, MI 48098, P. (248) 823-4091, listed as both Sold To and End User. Both quotes are titled "Troy School District: 2023 Pilot Furniture - Mar 15," were created 3/1/2023, revised 3/15/2023, and are valid through 4/30/2023. Prepared by Daryl Wendt; Opportunity #: 624468; Market Code: 2=2=K-12.

**Commercial terms**
Contract information on both quotes: OT8142CZ1 Sourcewell #121919-KII -Delv/Inst. Requested delivery date: To be Determined. Ship To is The Interior Group - Warehouse, Attn: Brad White 248-884-3828, 2195 S Milford Rd Suite E, Milford, MI 48381; installation by The Interior Group at the same address, P. 248.714.5756, F. 248.714.5791, Vendor # 15336. Sales team: Chris Halatek, Dealer Rep, chris.halatek@ki.com, 248-408-0978; Daryl Wendt, Inside Sales, daryl.wendt@ki.com, (877) 639-0643. Delivery, freight, off-loading and installation are included as one install trip to one location during normal business hours; storage and removal of existing items are excluded. Orders must ship within 120 days of KI receiving the order. Estimated sales tax on both quotes reads "See Notes."

**Finishes**
Seating is specified in Starlight Silver Metallic (/SX) frames with No Fire Retardant (/NFR) Blue Grey (/PGR) shells. MyPlace upholstery is KOM material from ARCCOM, pattern CRYSTAL, color MIDNIGHT, at $51.19 per yard: 6.2 yards per rectangle unit with a net upcharge of $317.38, and 4.6 yards per lounge chair with a net upcharge of $235.47, all with No Moisture Barrier (/NMB) and compliance to TB 117-2013. C-Table Max units use Kensington Maple edge (/EKM) and KI Laminate KENSINGTON MAPLE 10776-60 (/LKM). The Baker Tattoo Tower uses Arc pull, 4 casters-2 locking (black), Key Alike Lock #111 and Satin Chrome lock color.

**Purchase order requirements**
Purchase orders must be issued to KI or KI c/o the dealer at the Green Bay address and must carry Sold To/Bill To and Ship To detail, PO number, issue date, sales tax treatment, PO total, an authorized signature, and either a fully optioned KI quote reference (example given: 11KGH-85432) or full line-item detail. Signatures on a quote or worksheet cannot be accepted as a purchase order; incomplete orders are held and not released to manufacturing. Assistance line: 1-800-424-2432. Sales are governed by the terms at www.KI.com/terms.
2023_058_ki_secondary.verbose:
KI quotation package for the Troy School District "2023 Pilot Furniture" initiative, carried on the March 21, 2023 Board of Education agenda under the title KI_Secondary. The package contains two separate quotations prepared by Daryl Wendt of KI, both created 3/1/2023, revised 3/15/2023, and valid through 4/30/2023, both tied to Opportunity #: 624468 and Market Code: 2=2=K-12.

PARTIES AND CONTRACT TERMS
KI's order address is 1330 Bellevue Street, Green Bay, WI 54302. Troy School District, 4400 Livemois Rd, Troy, MI 48098, P. (248) 823-4091, appears as both Sold To and End User. Ship To is The Interior Group - Warehouse, Attn: Brad White 248-884-3828, 2195 S Milford Rd Suite E, Milford, MI 48381. Installation is by The Interior Group, 2195 S Milford Rd Suite E, Milford, MI 48381, P. 248.714.5756, F. 248.714.5791, Vendor # 15336. The sales team is Chris Halatek, Dealer Rep, chris.halatek@ki.com, 248-408-0978, and Daryl Wendt, Inside Sales, daryl.wendt@ki.com, (877) 639-0643. Contract information on both quotes reads OT8142CZ1 Sourcewell #121919-KII -Delv/Inst, and the requested delivery date on both is "To be Determined." Client notes state that delivery, freight, off-loading and installation are included as one install trip to one location during normal business hours, covering receiving and off-loading, unboxing, inspection, delivery, assembly, staging in the rooms, and removal of packaging and debris; storage and removal of existing items are excluded; additional costs apply if an elevator is unavailable or a stair carry is required, or if staging areas, dock, floor, receiving area or power access are inadequate; chrome or metallic frames are an upcharge on some items; a tax-exemption certificate must be on file; and orders must ship within 120 days of KI receiving the order.

LEAD TIMES AND SHIPPING
Both quotes carry an identical project lead time summary: manufacturing lead time begins once the order is complete and acknowledged, with delivery dates determined per order based on the longest lead time per shipping location and confirmed on the order acknowledgement. Ranges listed are Green Bay, WI 4-6 weeks; Pembroke, ONT 4-6 weeks; Bonduel, WI 5-7 weeks; and High Point, NC 6-8 weeks. Line-item lead times were calculated on 3/15/2023 and are subject to change; laminates or fabrics outside the standard KI ingrade program may extend lead times.

TAX, MATERIALS AND PURCHASE ORDER REQUIREMENTS
Estimated sales/use tax is calculated when the order is entered, and no tax is charged if a Resale Certificate, Exempt Organization Certificate, or Direct Pay permit is on file with KI's Finance Department. For Customer Owned/Ordered Materials (COM/COL/COV), materials are applied as swatched by the supplier, direction changes require a modification request that may affect yardage, yardage must factor pattern repeat, fabric on multiple rolls requires one additional yard per roll, material should come from a single dye lot, and materials must ship prepaid to the manufacturing facility, with further detail at www.ki.com/terms. Purchase orders must be issued to KI or KI c/o the dealer at 1330 Bellevue Street, Green Bay, WI 54302, and must include Sold To/Bill To information, Ship To information with contact name and phone, a purchase order number, issue date, sales tax treatment, purchase order total, an authorized signature, and order details referencing a fully optioned KI quote (example: 11KGH-85432) or listing quantity, complete model number with finishes and options, net and extended net price, additional charges such as installation or delivery, and the contract name or number. Signatures on a quote or worksheet cannot be accepted as a purchase order; customers without a formal PO process may call 1-800-424-2432. Purchase orders that do not meet the requirements are placed on hold, are not released to manufacturing, and are not assigned a delivery date. Sales resulting from purchase orders issued to KI are governed by the Terms and Conditions at www.KI.com/terms.
